thread:
vikram (Finance): Quick note: effective 2026-06-01 were launching two billing changes: (1) a small soft-overage protection for new customers and (2) richer invoice line items that show per-model and per-route usage. This should reduce disputes and make charges more transparent.

vikram (Finance): Key points:
- Soft overage protection: one-time cushion = $50 or 5% of monthly commit (lower) for first billing month after rollout.
- Invoice detail: each invoice will list model id, token counts, unit price, subtotal per-route.
- Dispute window reduced to 30 days (was 60).
- Effective: 2026-06-01. Migration proration handled by Finance.

ana (Support): For small unexpected charges, support should auto-apply the cushion for qualifying accounts and file a billing ticket. Canned response needed.

leo (Sales): Can we opt enterprise named accounts out or bump the cushion? We need an opt-out / manual carve-out flow for events.

legal-team: We'll prepare the TOS amendment and a short customer notice. Legal sign-off required before notice goes out.

billing-bot: Automated summary: policy:soft_overage_protection; cushion:$50_or_5pct; invoice_line_items:per_model; dispute_days:30; effective:2026-06-01; docs:https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/soft-overage

vikram (Finance): Action items: Finance to publish sample invoice snippets and migration plan; Support to draft canned responses; Sales to provide list of event-exempt accounts; Legal to finalize TOS notice. Target dates: docs by 2026-05-05, customer notice 2026-05-10.
